{"test_code":"from standings.ordinal import ordinal, ordinals


def test_teens_take_th() -> None:
    assert ordinal(11) == "11th"
    assert ordinal(12) == "12th"
    assert ordinal(13) == "13th"
    assert ordinal(111) == "111th"
    assert ordinal(112) == "112th"
    assert ordinal(113) == "113th"


def test_ordinals_teens() -> None:
    assert ordinals([10, 11, 12, 13]) == ["10th", "11th", "12th", "13th"]
","rationale":"Checks that 11, 12, 13 (and 111-113) get the 'th' suffix via ordinal and ordinals, as the docstring specifies."}
